zh: 穿上;戴上;舉辦(活動、展演)
tip: on=貼到身上或排上檔期,把東西「加上去」
example: Please put on your safety helmet before entering the factory.
exampleZh: 進入工廠前請戴上安全帽。

quiz.q: Our company puts ___ a trade show in Taipei every autumn.
quiz.explanation: put on=舉辦(展覽、活動),句中指公司每年秋天在台北辦展。put off=延後(要延的是已排定的特定活動);put out=熄滅/發布;put away=收好,語意皆不通。

tip: off=離開原本的時間點,把事情推離現在
example: We had to put off the product launch until next quarter.
exampleZh: 我們不得不把產品上市延到下一季。

quiz.q: The manager put ___ the interview because the candidate missed her flight.
quiz.explanation: put off=延後,應徵者錯過班機所以面試往後挪。put on=穿上/舉辦;put up=張貼/搭建;put out=熄滅/發布,語意皆不通。

tip: away=離開檯面,把用完的東西放回它原本該待的地方
example: Please put away the samples after the client meeting ends.
exampleZh: 客戶會議結束後請把樣品收好。

quiz.q: Remember to put ___ the tools before you leave the workshop.
quiz.explanation: put away=收好歸位,離開工作間前把工具收回原處。put off=延後;put on=穿上/舉辦;put forward=提出(建議、方案),語意皆不通。

zh: 熄滅;撲滅;發布(消息、聲明)
tip: 把東西往外送出去——火送走就滅了,消息送出去就是發布
example: Firefighters put out the warehouse blaze in less than an hour.
exampleZh: 消防員在一小時內撲滅了倉庫大火。

quiz.q: The company put ___ a press release to clarify the rumor.
quiz.explanation: put out=發布(新聞稿、聲明),公司發稿澄清謠言。put off=延後;put away=收好;put up=張貼/搭建,語意皆不通。

tip: 撐住(up)並與它共處(with),就是忍下來
example: Our staff had to put up with the broken air conditioner.
exampleZh: 我們的員工只能忍受壞掉的冷氣。

quiz.q: I can't put ___ with the constant noise from the construction site.
quiz.explanation: put up with=忍受,受不了工地不停的噪音。put off=延後;put away=收好;put out=熄滅/發布,都無法接 with 表示忍耐。

zh: 組裝;彙整;擬出(方案、報告)
tip: 把散落的零件或資料聚(together)成一份完整的東西
example: It took us a week to put together the annual report.
exampleZh: 我們花了一週才彙整出年度報告。

quiz.q: She put ___ a detailed proposal for the client in two days.
quiz.explanation: put together=彙整/擬出,兩天內做出一份完整提案。put off=延後;put away=收好;put on=穿上/舉辦(活動),語意皆不通。

zh: 擱置;暫時不管;存(錢)備用
tip: aside=挪到旁邊,不是丟掉,只是先放一邊
example: She puts aside a little money for emergencies every month.
exampleZh: 她每個月存一點錢以備不時之需。

quiz.q: It's time to put ___ our differences and work as one team.
quiz.explanation: put aside=擱置(歧見),先把分歧放一邊一起做事。put off=延後(整件事往後挪);put out=熄滅/發布;put up=張貼/搭建,語意皆不通。

tip: forward=往前推,把想法推到大家面前讓人看見
example: The team put forward a new plan to improve customer service.
exampleZh: 團隊提出了改善客服的新方案。

quiz.q: Several engineers put ___ ideas for cutting production costs.
quiz.explanation: put forward=提出(想法、方案),幾位工程師提出降低生產成本的點子。put off=延後;put away=收好;put up=張貼/搭建,語意皆不通。

zh: 起飛;脫下;(銷量)大幅成長
tip: off=離開地面或離開身體,飛機離地、衣服離身
example: Our flight will take off from Terminal Two at nine.
exampleZh: 我們的班機九點從第二航廈起飛。

quiz.q: Sales of the new phone really took ___ after the ad campaign.
quiz.explanation: take off=(銷量)一飛沖天,廣告後買氣大增。take over=接管;take on=承擔/僱用;take up=開始從事/佔用時間,語意皆不通。

tip: over=從對方手上越過來,責任換人扛
example: Ms. Lin will take over the department when the director retires.
exampleZh: 主任退休後,林小姐將接管這個部門。

quiz.q: A larger firm plans to take ___ our supplier next year.
quiz.explanation: take over=併購/接管,一家更大的公司要吃下我們的供應商。take off=起飛/脫下;take up=開始從事;take after=長相或個性像長輩,語意皆不通。

tip: on=把事情或人放到自己肩上扛
example: He agreed to take on two more projects this quarter.
exampleZh: 他答應這一季再多接兩個專案。

quiz.q: The factory will take ___ extra workers before the peak season.
quiz.explanation: take on=僱用,工廠在旺季前要多請一批人手。take off=起飛/脫下;take over=接管;take up=開始從事/佔空間,語意皆不通。

zh: 取出;外帶;辦理(保險、貸款)
tip: out=從裡面拿到外面,東西、餐點甚至保單都能「取出來」
example: The company took out insurance to cover the shipping risk.
exampleZh: 公司投保以涵蓋運送過程的風險。

quiz.q: Could you take ___ the documents from the cabinet before the audit?
quiz.explanation: take out=取出,稽核前把文件從櫃子裡拿出來。take off=脫下/起飛;take over=接管;take back=收回/退貨,語意皆不通。

zh: 收回(說過的話);退回(商品)
tip: back=回到原處,說出的話或賣出的貨都收回去
example: The store will take back any item within thirty days.
exampleZh: 這家店三十天內接受任何商品退貨。

quiz.q: I apologize and take ___ what I said at the meeting.
quiz.explanation: take back=收回說過的話,道歉並收回會議上的發言。take off=起飛/脫下;take over=接管;take up=開始從事,語意皆不通。

zh: 開始從事(嗜好、工作);佔用(時間、空間)
tip: up=把東西拿起來開始做,或往上堆而佔掉位置
example: These files take up too much space on the shared drive.
exampleZh: 這些檔案佔用共用硬碟太多空間。

quiz.q: After moving to Taichung, she took ___ yoga to relieve stress.
quiz.explanation: take up=開始從事(某項嗜好),搬到台中後開始練瑜伽。take on=承擔工作/僱用;take over=接管;take off=起飛/脫下,語意皆不通。

tip: down=往下拿,把牆上的東西取下,或把話落到紙上
example: Please take down the old posters before the new display arrives.
exampleZh: 新的陳列品送到前,請先把舊海報拆下來。

quiz.q: The assistant took ___ every detail of the client's request.
quiz.explanation: take down=記下,助理把客戶要求的每個細節都記錄下來。take off=起飛/脫下;take over=接管;take up=開始從事/佔用,語意皆不通。

tip: after=跟在後面走,孩子沿著長輩的樣子長
example: She takes after her father in both looks and personality.
exampleZh: 她的長相和個性都像她父親。

quiz.q: Everyone says the young manager takes ___ his grandfather.
quiz.explanation: take after=長相或個性像長輩,大家都說這位年輕經理像他祖父。take over=接管;take on=承擔;take up=開始從事,都不能用來說「像某人」。

tip: for=為了某個目標,眼睛朝那個目標找過去
example: We are looking for a supplier who can deliver within a week.
exampleZh: 我們正在找能在一週內交貨的供應商。

quiz.q: He is looking ___ a part-time job near the campus.
quiz.explanation: look for=尋找,他在找校園附近的兼職。look after=照顧;look over=把文件從頭掃過一遍;look up=查單字或資料,語意皆不通。

tip: after=眼睛跟在對方後面,隨時顧著
example: Could you look after the front desk while I'm at the conference?
exampleZh: 我去開會時,可以幫忙顧一下櫃檯嗎?

quiz.q: A neighbor looks ___ their cat whenever they travel abroad.
quiz.explanation: look after=照顧,他們出國時鄰居會幫忙照顧貓。look for=尋找;look into=調查;look up=查資料,語意皆不通。

tip: into=眼光鑽進事情內部,不只看表面
example: Our team will look into the shipping delay right away.
exampleZh: 我們團隊會立刻調查出貨延誤的原因。

quiz.q: The bank promised to look ___ the customer's billing complaint.
quiz.explanation: look into=調查,銀行承諾查明客戶的帳單申訴。look out=當心(提醒危險);look for=尋找;look up=查詢單字或資料,語意皆不通。

tip: 眼睛朝前方(forward)望向還沒到的那件事
example: We look forward to working with your team next year.
exampleZh: 我們期待明年與貴團隊合作。

quiz.q: I'm looking ___ to your reply about the contract terms.
quiz.explanation: look forward to=期待,期待對方回覆合約條款。look after=照顧;look into=調查;look over=檢視,三者都不接 to 表示期待。

zh: 查詢(單字、資料);(情況)好轉
tip: up=把資料從書本或系統裡抬出來給你看
example: Look up the client's address in the shared contact list.
exampleZh: 請到共用聯絡清單裡查客戶的地址。

quiz.q: If you don't know the term, look it ___ in the manual.
quiz.explanation: look up=查詢,不懂的術語就翻手冊查;它可拆開,受詞是代名詞時必須說 look it up。look into=調查(事件);look after=照顧;look for=尋找(不見的東西),語意皆不通,而且三者都不可拆開,不能說 look it into。

tip: 視線從頭到尾掃過(over)一遍,先求大致確認
example: Please look over the contract before we sign it tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我們明天簽約前,請先看過這份合約。

quiz.q: The supervisor looked ___ my report and found two typos.
quiz.explanation: look over=檢視,主管看過報告後抓出兩個錯字。look after=照顧;look for=尋找;look forward (to)=期待,語意皆不通。

tip: out=把注意力放到外面,盯著可能撞上來的危險
example: Look out for hidden fees when you compare the two plans.
exampleZh: 比較這兩個方案時要當心隱藏費用。

quiz.q: Look ___! The forklift is coming around the corner.
quiz.explanation: look out=小心,堆高機正要轉彎過來。look into=調查;look after=照顧;look up=查詢,都不能用來提醒危險。

tip: through=從頭穿到尾,一頁一頁翻過去
example: He looked through the whole catalog and marked three possible models.
exampleZh: 他翻完整本型錄,標出三個可能的機型。

quiz.q: She looked ___ the résumés and picked five candidates to interview.
quiz.explanation: look through=逐份翻閱,她翻過履歷後挑出五位人選來面試。look after=照顧;look for=尋找;look out=當心,語意皆不通。

tip: along=並肩往同方向走,關係順順地往前
example: She gets along well with everyone in the sales department.
exampleZh: 她和業務部的每個人都相處得很好。

quiz.q: It takes time to get ___ with a new supervisor.
quiz.explanation: get along with=與人相處,和新主管磨合需要時間。get over=克服;get through=完成/接通;get ahead=出人頭地,語意皆不通。

tip: over=翻過一座山,難關被留在身後
example: It took him a month to get over the flu.
exampleZh: 他花了一個月才從流感中康復。

quiz.q: Once you get ___ your fear of public speaking, presenting becomes easy.
quiz.explanation: get over=克服(恐懼),克服上台恐懼後簡報就變輕鬆。get along=相處融洽;get through=做完工作/電話接通;get ahead=出人頭地,語意皆不通。

zh: 完成(大量工作);(電話)接通;度過(難關)
tip: through=從一頭穿到另一頭,穿出來就結束了
example: I couldn't get through to their customer service all morning.
exampleZh: 我整個早上都打不通他們的客服電話。

quiz.q: We must get ___ this pile of invoices before Friday.
quiz.explanation: get through=做完(一大疊工作),週五前要處理完這疊發票。get over=克服;get along=相處融洽;get ahead=出人頭地,語意皆不通。

tip: back=把回應送回去給對方,或把話題拉回原點
example: I'll get back to you with the quotation by Thursday.
exampleZh: 我會在週四前把報價回覆給你。

quiz.q: Let me check the stock and get ___ to you this afternoon.
quiz.explanation: get back to someone=稍後回覆對方,查完庫存下午回覆你。get over=克服;get along=相處融洽;get through=完成/接通,語意皆不通。

tip: rid=使擺脫,get rid of 就是把礙事的東西從身邊清掉
example: We should get rid of the outdated brochures in storage.
exampleZh: 我們應該把倉庫裡過期的文宣丟掉。

quiz.q: The new software helps us get ___ of most paper forms.
quiz.explanation: get rid of=去除/擺脫,新軟體讓多數紙本表單消失。get over=克服(疾病、難關),後面直接接受詞不接 of;get through=完成一大堆工作,也不接 of;get ahead of 雖然存在,但意思是「搶在…之前、領先」(get ahead of the competition),用來說消滅表單並不通。

zh: 領先;出人頭地;更上一層樓
tip: ahead=跑到別人前面,在職涯上往前站一步
example: Learning a second language can help you get ahead at work.
exampleZh: 學第二外語有助於你在職場更上一層樓。

quiz.q: He works extra hours because he wants to get ___ in the company.
quiz.explanation: get ahead=在公司裡往上爬,他加班是為了求升遷。get along=相處融洽;get over=克服;get through=完成/接通,語意皆不通。
